## Summary

Describe the foundation or milestone change.

## Scope Control

- [ ] The change is within the stated milestone.
- [ ] No real patient or organisation data is included.
- [ ] No unapproved estate decision, saving, or operational outcome is claimed.

## Quality Checks

- [ ] `python3 -m ruff check .`
- [ ] `python3 -m ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `python3 -m mypy src tests`
- [ ] `python3 -m pytest`
- [ ] `make quality`
